Point 1. The August invoice carries a storage overage billed a month behind, so the line you are reading in August is the storage used in July. The rate did not change and the volume did, which is why the number looks like a price rise and is not one. The two lines you asked about are the same overage split across the two accounts the contract names, and they add up to the single figure on the summary page.
